label: Quotient Blog (document view)
description: The Quotient blog DOCUMENT surface, matched to the real app and CHROMELESS like quotient-social/quotient-campaign: doc header row (Last updated, campaign chip, Threads, Draft/Published status pill), hero image, title + dek, Authors/Slug/Tags/Publish Date meta rows, word count, and body prose. App chrome comes from quotient-app-shell -- stage this in its content region (or inset on its own for a full-frame doc beat). The 'publish-blog' script action flips the header pill from Draft to the green rocket Published state -- the blog's money beat. Also scroll-doc and highlight-hero.

campaign.label: Campaign chip + breadcrumb segment (e.g. 'Weekly Blog Post')

published_when.label: Text after 'Published' on the pill (e.g. 'just now')

word_count.label: Word count shown above the body

last_updated.label: LEGACY: no longer displayed (the real docbar is controls-only)

script.label: Timed actions: publish-blog {at, published_when?}, highlight-hero {at}, scroll-doc {at, amount, duration}. Cursor targets: 'status', 'hero'.

docked.label: true = riding quotient-app-shell's white content card: strips the outer window chrome so the surface merges with the card.

campaign_progress.label: Campaign chip progress, e.g. '0/1' (adds the count + ring like the real docbar)
